headline: Fresh Clashes Shake Marban Hollow and Weathered Expanse Fronts
war_summary: Renewed combat convulsed the central and northern fronts over the past three hours, punctuated by fresh base transfers in Marban Hollow, Weathered Expanse, and Nevish Line. Marban Hollow saw sharp localized exchanges around Oster Wall and Checkpoint Bua as casualties climbed, while Weathered Expanse witnessed renewed sector shifts amid a ferocious exchange that claimed over twenty-one hundred casualties in two hours. To the northwest, Nevish Line maintained its violent rhythm with multiple base actions across Blackcoat Way and Grief Mother alongside accelerating losses. Massive attrition raged unabated across Callahan's Passage, where casualty rates surged with over twenty-two hundred combined losses in the last two hours despite unyielding fortified lines. Meanwhile, Stonecradle and Palantine Berm sustained heavy pressure and mounting butcher's bills, whereas earlier hotspots in Linn of Mercy, Godcrofts, and Stlican Shelf experienced a relative lull in active base conversions.
